title: Because He lives
lyrics_original: God sent His Son, they called Him Jesus
He came to love, heal and forgive
He lived and died, to buy my pardon
An empty grave, is there to prove, my Savior lives
Because He lives,
I can face tomorrow
Because He lives,
all fear is gone
Because I know,
He holds the future
And life is worth,
the living just, because He lives
How sweet to hold, a newborn baby
And feel the pride, and joy He brings
But greater still, the calm assurance
This child can face, uncertain days, because He lives
And then one day, I’ll cross the river
I’ll fight life’s final, war with pain
And then as death, gives way to victory
I’ll see the lights, of glory and, I’ll know He lives
author_english: Jason Ingram, Bill Gaither, Gloria Gaither, Chris Tomlin, Matt Maher, Daniel Carson, Ed Cash

bible_verses.telugu: అయితే మీరు నన్ను చూతురు. నేను జీవించుచున్నాను గనుక మీరును జీవింతురు.
bible_verses.english: Before long, the world will not see me anymore, but you will see me. Because I live, you also will live.

bible_verses.telugu: అయితే దేవుడు మనయెడల తన ప్రేమను వెల్లడిపరచుచున్నాడు; ఎట్లనగా మనమింకను పాపులమై యుండగానే క్రీస్తు మనకొరకు చనిపోయెను.
bible_verses.english: But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

bible_verses.telugu: దేవుడు మనకు శక్తియు ప్రేమయు, ఇంద్రియ నిగ్రహమునుగల ఆత్మనే యిచ్చెను గాని పిరికితనముగల ఆత్మ నియ్యలేదు.
bible_verses.english: For the Spirit God gave us does not make us timid, but gives us power, love and self-discipline.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for coming to love, heal, and redeem me through Your life, death, and resurrection. I praise You that Your grave is empty and that You are alive today, holding my future with loving hands. Whenever fear or uncertainty tries to creep into my heart, remind me that my life is anchored in Your victory. Help me to step into tomorrow with confidence, knowing that because You live, I can face anything. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: The resurrection of Jesus isn't just a powerful historical event; it is our daily source of courage and peace. Because our Savior lives, we no longer have to carry the heavy weight of fear or worry about what tomorrow holds. His empty grave guarantees that love has conquered death and that our future is securely in His hands. Today, let this truth quiet your anxieties and fill your heart with steady, unshakable hope.
